name: folded lines join without a space
clip chomping drops the final line break
a double-quoted scalar loses its trailing blanks
find:
{text: "#{out}#{ws}", r:, c: c + 1}
  elsif not double
replace:
{text: out, r:, c: c + 1}
  elsif not double

name: a repeated key is refused for the wrong reason
one document reads as a stream of documents
a flow sequence key may end on the next line
find: same_line = explicit or not in_seq or r2 == k[:r]
replace: same_line = explicit or not in_seq or true
